description.value:
Sometimes accuracy isn't important. Sometimes you want to spray lead and witness the havoc once the smoke clears. In that case, seek no further than the Shigure. This SMG from the early 21st century might be getting on in years, and it might not have the firepower of more recent models, but it can unload more bullets in a minute than all of Arasaka's unprosecuted counts of tax fraud. Meaning a lot.

Cost: 500eb (Expensive)

Class: Heavy SMG • Skill: Handgun • Range: SMG

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 50 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 2 • Attachments: Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: This weapon expends 15 rounds per Autofire use. If there are not 15 rounds left in the magazine for Autofire (SMG 4), the entire magazine is expended as Autofire (SMG 3) instead.

Range: SMG
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
